prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a unique illustrated cover for Hopmodo's Push-up Flight camera game, also used on its start screen. Create a polished playful 3D clay-like miniature illustration, landscape 3:2 composition, soft studio lighting, rounded matte shapes with restrained material texture and crisp silhouettes. Main scene: a tiny teal and cream helicopter with a warm coral propeller flying through two rounded arch gates above a calm stylized landscape. The helicopter is the unmistakable main subject; show movement and a welcoming sense of play. Keep important subjects in the central 75% so the cover can crop at different sizes. Blue-teal atmosphere with warm cream and coral accents, uncluttered background. No text, no logos, no UI, no watermarks, no photoreal people. Output a single finished raster illustration, not a contact sheet.
